decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents)

Condition : 5 - No additional windows shall be installed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved without the written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To protect the amenities of the neighbouring residential property against increased overlooking and to safeguard the visual amenity of the area.

Condition : 6 - The off street parking spaces shown on drawing No. 426/1 shall be constructed and available for use before the first occupation of the development and the spaces shall be permanently available and not to be used for any other purpose.

Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and premises, in the interests of road safety.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) and Residential Extension Guidelines, of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a three storey side extension, part three storey rear extension and erection of a single storey rear extension to existing flats.
